videos.caption: President Donald Trump renewed his threat to rename Lake Ontario “Lake America” in a clip posted to his TikTok account on Wednesday. Trump first floated the change on Truth Social a day earlier, as trade tensions between the United States and Canada escalated following the breakdown of negotiations and the introduction of new tariffs. Lake Ontario is one of the five Great Lakes and straddles the US–Canada border, with New York on its southern shore and the Canadian province of Ontario to the north. Trump could direct US federal agencies to adopt a different name, as he did with the Gulf of Mexico in 2025, but he could not require Canada or international bodies to recognize it. #lakeontario #canada #geopolitics
